test_stream_unary_interceptor: test the StreamUnaryClientInterceptor by intercepting client streaming RPC calls with request iterators
create_stream_unary_interceptor_empty: create a StreamUnaryClientInterceptor that passes through calls without modifying the request iterator
create_stream_unary_interceptor_with_ite: create a StreamUnaryClientInterceptor that wraps the request iterator with a CountingRequestIterator
test_interceptor_cancel_before_rpc: test cancelling a streaming RPC call before the interceptor completes the continuation
test_interceptor_exception_handling: test that exceptions raised by a StreamUnaryClientInterceptor propagate correctly to the caller
